Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Krallenhorde Howler.

When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

Cast Proctor of Potential by paying {W}{U}.
When Proctor of Potential enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Proctor of Potential triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.
1339-6625-8166.notes: If desired, the cards you surveil can be put into your graveyard, but this will net less overall loops of the combo.

2034-2577-6763-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

243-628-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

3317-5972-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-5972-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3317-5972-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

864-2104-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Eternal Witness.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Eternal Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

141-4050-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
141-4050-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-5527-7170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-5527-7170.description:

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-6281-6435-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Coati Scavenger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Coati Scavenger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Coati Scavenger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

1090-5147-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-5147-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

372-3742-4753.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Clever Impersonator to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Phantom Steed.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clever Impersonator and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

1294-2167-2573-2638-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
1294-2167-2573-2638-4423.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a basic Forest and any other land you control, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Play the Forest and another land from your graveyard.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Tracker's first ability triggers twice, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Tireless Tracker's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Clue ability, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2048-2103-2707.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.
